thread:
maria: Kicking off a 10% staged rollout for v2024.12 (canary) in us-east + eu-central. QA flagged truncated parses when requests hit hot KV-cache paths under burst load in eu-central. Can we pause and take a quick stop/go?

deploy-bot: deploy 1887654321 started by maria — canary -> 10%. healthy targets 5/50. logs: `runtime.kvcache` stream attached.

owen: I see a pattern: when concurrent requests touch the same cache shard the tokenizer output gets clipped at ~1k tokens. Seems like a race in cache eviction + tokenizer buffer. Not the usual tokenizer binary.

karen: Packaging shipped the new kv-cache sharding improvement with a subtle ordering change. Fallback here would be to pin to kv-legacy mode or enable `kv.cache_compat=true`.

ops-runner: Ops suggestion: hold at 10%, flip remote config `kv.cache_compat=true` on rollout=canary to restore previous ordering, then observe 10-15m. If truncation >0.5% persists, roll back to v2024.11.

maria: Agreed. Prefer a config flip over immediate full rollback. Who runs it?

deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl config set kv.cache_compat=true --selector rollout=canary --env=prod`
deploy-bot: matched 5 targets, applying...
deploy-bot: config applied to 5/5 targets. status=success. change-id=cfg-1887654321-compat

ops-runner: Monitoring now. first 6m: truncation incidents in eu-central down from 0.8% -> 0.1%. latency p95 stable. Recommend bake 20m before resuming ramp.

owen: Ran a 300-sample replay against canary IPs: 298/300 intact, 2 truncated near shard boundaries. Looks much better. Will keep replays running.

karen: I'll open a follow-up PR to reorder the eviction path and add a regression test for concurrent shard hits. PR: `fix/kv-eviction-order`

release-manager: Change window til 21:00 UTC. Quick vote: thumbs up to proceed to 25% after bake, thumbs down to keep hold/rollback. Please vote.

maria: :thumbsup: (after 20m bake)

owen: :thumbsup: (replay healthy)

karen: :thumbsup: (packaging follow-up tracked)

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (I'll keep runbooks open)

release-manager: Consensus -> ramp post-bake. Annotating rollout ticket. Schedule: ramp to 25% at ~1887655521 unless a hold is set.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 1887654321: "kv.cache_compat=true applied; bake window started; change-id=cfg-1887654321-compat"

maria: Thanks everyone. If any truncation spikes during bake call emergency:rollback. Otherwise we'll continue the staged ramp.

deploy-bot: scheduled ramp to 25% at 1887655521 (ETA ~18m).

ops-runner: Note for post-deploy: track token-clip metric and add an alert threshold at 0.4% so future waves auto-hold.

maria: Good call. Also adding a short blurb to release notes about the kv-cache ordering change and the temporary compat flag so support has guidance.

release-manager: Added release-note TODO and assigned to karen for the packaging PR. Closing the vote thread.

deploy-bot: rollout 1887654321 current state: canary=10%, bake=running."
